acceptedAnswer.text: We service Parramatta and the suburbs listed on this page. If you do not see yours, send us a message with your suburb. If you are close to Parramatta, we may still be able to help.

mainEntity.name: Do prices change depending on my suburb?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We use the same price ranges across the area: most domestic repairs cost $150 to $450 including parts, with a call-out fee of about $60 to $200. You get a fixed quote before we start.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can a technician get to me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our technicians are based locally, so travel time is short. Same-day visits are available where we have a slot, and booking early in the day gives you the best chance. We confirm a time when you book.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair commercial fridges and coolrooms in these suburbs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We repair commercial fridges, freezers, coolrooms and ice machines for cafes, restaurants, shops and other businesses across the same area. Commercial jobs are quoted separately.

mainEntity.name: Can you come after hours or on weekends?

acceptedAnswer.text: We take urgent calls and after-hours requests. Book online or email us with your suburb and what the fridge is doing, and we confirm the fastest time we can get there.

mainEntity.name: What should I tell you when I book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your suburb, the brand and model of the fridge or freezer, and what it is doing. If you are in an apartment or a shopping centre, tell us about any access rules, such as lift bookings or loading dock times, so we arrive prepared.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair all brands in every suburb?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We repair most makes of domestic and commercial fridges and freezers in every suburb we cover. Have your model number ready when you book.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed to work on refrigeration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our work is carried out by licensed refrigeration mechanics (Lic #R38910) who are ARC licensed to handle refrigerant. We are independent and not tied to any brand.
